title: Let the music play, down on Fraggle Rock An afternoon at Jim Henson’s...
transcript: I'm at the Jim Henson Creature Shop and this is the coolest place I've maybe ever been New Victory Theater is bringing the Fraggles to the stage and I got an exclusive behind the scenes look at their new show Jim Henson's Fraggle Rock back to the Rock Live and it felt like I was stepping directly into my childhood I got to go on a tour of the Jim Henson Creature Shop in Long Island City and learn about how these puppets are actually built and performed the amount of artistry behind it is unbelievable believable every tiny movement and expression takes so much detail and collaboration it gave me such an appreciation for this craft and I love what New Victory is doing with Fraggle Rock it truly feels designed for everyone yes kids and families but also for the nostalgic adults like they are even doing their own grown up nights which feels so correct because who doesn't love the fragiles and perhaps the best part of the entire day I got to meet Red Fraggle she was my absolute favourite if you grew up loving Fraggle Rock or just love the joyful heartfelt magic of Jim Henson you can't miss Jim Henson's Fraggle Rock back to the Rock live
